model.note: Part outlines are traced from a dealer photo of a Terra Rake 230 (seen from the tractor side) and are approximate. Wiedenmann publishes no parts book for the 230: the only part number is the Tines Direct tine reference, which still needs confirming as the OEM number; everything else goes through a Wiedenmann dealer.

tines.name: Spring tines (4 rows)
tines.desc: Four rows of spring tines at 16 mm row spacing, 2260 mm working width. Tine: 4.6 mm wire, 41 mm coil, 260 mm long, 65 mm wide; Tines Direct (UK) ref W1196554, GBP 5.75 ex VAT each, no AU price found: confirm it is the Wiedenmann OEM number with the dealer. Wiedenmann gives a 5-year 'no broken tines' warranty: keep broken tines and claim before buying. Daily: all tines present, none broken (they snap on rocks and roots). Drive 10 to 15 km/h for full tine vibration and never reverse with the tines in the turf. After use clean the tines (water is fine but dry them to stop rust); avoid compressed air, it blows dirt into the bearings. The old Notion 'approx 10 mm dia, part enquire' row is wrong.

frame.name: Main frame
frame.desc: Terra Rake 230: machine width 2300 mm, working width 2260 mm, 188 kg (191 kg with the strain-relief kit). After use check for loose parts and corrosion. Before the season, or after a long standstill, lubricate and service the whole machine, re-torque fasteners to the metric torque table (for example M12 8.8 dry 95 Nm, M16 8.8 dry 240 Nm) and touch up paint on frame damage. No telematics.

headstock.name: Three-point frame (Cat 0 / Cat 1)
headstock.desc: Tractor 3-point linkage, no PTO. Top link heights are given for Cat 0 and Cat 1 only (the old Notion 'Cat 1/2' is wrong). Minimum tractor 18 kW (25 hp). Before use: 3-point pins and linch pins in.

links.name: End linkage
links.desc: Linkage at each end of the tine frame. Keep exposed parts, threaded spindles and guides lightly lubricated. After use check for loose parts.

wheels.name: Sensing (support) wheels
wheels.desc: 180 mm sensing wheels: the only grease point on the machine. Grease the bearing nipples (clean the nipple first, wipe off excess grease); no OEM interval is given, monthly in use is a suggestion. Check they turn freely before use. Part numbers are not published: order through a Wiedenmann dealer (AU dealer not confirmed).

adjust.name: Depth adjustment
adjust.desc: Working depth and aggression are set by the depth adjustment at the sensing wheels. Before use check the adjustment pins and clips are present.

axle.name: Tine axle, clamping sleeves and hex nuts
axle.desc: Daily: tine hex nuts tight and the clamping sleeves on the axle ends in place. To replace broken spring elements: loosen the hex nuts on the faulty elements, remove the clamping sleeves both ends, pull the axle out, swap the elements, refit the axle and tap the sleeves back in, tighten the nuts. Sleeve and nut part numbers are not published: Wiedenmann dealer.
